title: Amtrak reports all 47 historically identified station-access and amenity deficiencies addressed by fiscal 2019
summary: The FY24-29 plan states that all 47 stations in the historically identified entrance, exit, restroom, or ticket-counter deficiency cohort had been addressed by fiscal 2019. Denominator: The plan's fixed 47-station historical access-and-amenity deficiency cohort, not the full 385-station responsibility portfolio.
